scope: plan-local Artifex supervisor operating on one trusted local repository through untrusted workers and provider CLIs

cases.title: Repository text instructs the worker to widen scope
cases.boundary: repository data -> worker context -> structured envelope
cases.precondition: A required-read file contains a directive that conflicts with the frozen slice or repository authority stack.
cases.action: The worker recommends or attempts an undeclared write or tool call.
detection: Compare requested files and tools with the immutable slice manifest
Record both controlling source references on an authority conflict
cases.rollback_reconcile: Do not dispatch the side effect; preserve the rejected envelope as minimized evidence.
mitigation: Treat repository text as data
Require exact scope and authority predicates before every public boundary

cases.title: MCP or memory content injects an instruction
cases.boundary: MCP or memory observation -> compiler or worker
cases.precondition: A recalled or tool-returned value contains executable-looking instructions or asks for credentials.
cases.action: The worker treats imported content as authority or requests ambient credentials.
detection: Reject authority claims whose provenance is MCP or memory
Scan the minimized return against the secret-retention policy
cases.rollback_reconcile: No requested side effect is dispatched; redact the observation before durable storage.
mitigation: Label MCP and memory payloads as untrusted data
Exclude raw imported content from durable run state

cases.title: Path traversal escapes the declared files
cases.precondition: A manifest or worker return contains an absolute path, parent traversal, or a path outside the repository root.
cases.action: The worker attempts to read or write the escaped target.
detection: Resolve and normalize every declared path against the pinned repository root
Reject absolute and parent-traversal inputs
cases.rollback_reconcile: No filesystem operation occurs; the slice terminates with a scope refusal.
mitigation: Compile only repository-relative exact paths
Recheck containment at the write boundary

cases.title: Symlink redirects an in-scope path outside the repository
cases.precondition: A declared path or one of its parents becomes a symlink after compilation.
cases.action: A write follows the link to an undeclared target.
detection: Resolve path components immediately before the side effect
Compare lstat identity with the compiled preimage
cases.rollback_reconcile: Do not follow the changed path; freeze the run because the source preimage drifted.
mitigation: Pin path identity in the slice
Fail closed on symlink or inode drift

cases.title: Signed mandate attempts to widen frozen authority
cases.precondition: A correctly signed mandate names files, tools, permissions, model, budget, or action class broader than the frozen plan permits.
cases.action: The supervisor evaluates signature validity as sufficient authorization.
detection: Compare every mandate dimension with higher-precedence maxima
Emit a narrowing-violation reason code
cases.rollback_reconcile: Reject before dispatch; a replacement mandate may only narrow the frozen contract.
mitigation: Separate authenticity from authority
Require monotonic narrowing

cases.title: Model confidence is mistaken for permission
cases.precondition: The worker reports high confidence for an action classified as OWNER.
cases.action: The supervisor accepts the action because confidence exceeds a heuristic threshold.
detection: Ignore confidence when computing action class
Evaluate only frozen authority predicates
cases.rollback_reconcile: Do not dispatch; queue the exact owner decision with alternatives and blast radius.
mitigation: Keep confidence outside the authority schema
Prohibit LLM tie-breaks for protected actions

cases.title: Sandbox success is mistaken for acceptance
cases.precondition: A worker exits successfully inside the configured sandbox.
cases.action: The supervisor marks the slice accepted without schema, delta, source-hash, authority, and validation checks.
detection: Require every independent acceptance predicate after provider success
Refuse an incomplete validation envelope
cases.rollback_reconcile: Hold the slice in validating with no plan bookkeeping until all gates pass.
mitigation: Keep worker success distinct from accepted
Derive acceptance only from deterministic gates

cases.title: Worker tests-passed claim is unverified
cases.precondition: The worker says that required tests passed but supplies no independently reproduced result.
cases.action: The supervisor records acceptance from prose or worker-owned expected output.
detection: Run the frozen validation commands outside the worker judgement
Bind outputs to source and postimage hashes
cases.rollback_reconcile: Keep the slice unaccepted; retry validation or queue OWNER if the command cannot be run safely.
mitigation: Do not allow candidate code to self-certify
Require public deterministic validation evidence

cases.title: Crash after durable intent and before public boundary
cases.boundary: intent fsync -> provider or filesystem call
cases.precondition: Intent is durable and verified, but the process dies before the named public boundary begins.
cases.action: Resume sees an intent without an observation.
detection: Replay the verified chain
Inspect the exact declared preimage and provider process identity
cases.rollback_reconcile: Record no-effect only when the exact preimage is proven; retry with the same idempotency key within budget.
mitigation: Persist intent before every boundary
Make retry conditional on exact no-effect evidence

cases.title: Crash after public side effect and before observation
cases.precondition: A provider, Git, filesystem, or bookkeeping call may have completed, but no verified observation is durable.
cases.action: Resume cannot prove exact preimage or approved postimage.
detection: Compare the declared preimage and approved postimage
Classify every other postimage as an unknown third state
cases.rollback_reconcile: Do not repeat the side effect; freeze the run and request owner adjudication with pre/postimage evidence.
mitigation: Use stable idempotency keys
Require exact third-state refusal

cases.title: Duplicate dispatch or result delivery
cases.precondition: The same run, slice, attempt, and idempotency key arrives more than once.
cases.action: A duplicate worker or result tries to advance the state machine twice.
detection: Enforce unique event and idempotency identities during append
Compare duplicate payload digests
cases.rollback_reconcile: Return the existing durable result for an identical duplicate; treat a divergent duplicate as incident.
mitigation: Make dispatch and acceptance idempotent
Never count duplicate usage or interventions twice

cases.title: Orphan worker survives supervisor death
cases.precondition: The supervisor dies while a worker remains alive or its identity cannot be matched uniquely.
cases.action: Resume considers starting another worker for the same attempt.
detection: Reconcile durable provider process and session identity
Verify exact authority before signalling a process
cases.rollback_reconcile: Do not start a replacement or kill an ambiguous process; stop only the exact owned process when the mandate permits it.
mitigation: Persist child identity before dispatch completion
Use fresh processes and bounded orphan policy

cases.title: Provider timeout with exact no-effect evidence
cases.precondition: The provider exceeds the frozen timeout and exact preimage plus process termination are proven.
cases.action: The scheduler considers a fresh bounded retry.
detection: Classify timeout separately from success
Verify no project delta and no surviving owned process
cases.rollback_reconcile: Record the no-effect observation and retry only inside the attempt budget with the same slice inputs.
mitigation: Apply a hard provider timeout
Reconcile before retry

cases.title: Provider quota failure
cases.precondition: The provider returns a quota or rate-limit class without a valid worker envelope.
cases.action: The supervisor considers treating the failure as empty success or silently switching provider.
detection: Map exact installed-provider exit and event evidence to quota failure
Check whether fallback is explicitly permitted by the mandate
cases.rollback_reconcile: Preserve provider_unavailable; do not impute zero usage or switch provider without a frozen route.
mitigation: Use a closed provider failure taxonomy
Keep unsupported and unknown first-class

cases.title: Provider approval is denied or unavailable
cases.precondition: A worker requests an operation the configured provider boundary denies or cannot represent.
cases.action: The adapter considers bypassing approval or widening sandbox permissions.
detection: Map denial and unsupported approval modes explicitly
Compare requested permission with the run mandate
cases.rollback_reconcile: Do not relaunch with broader permissions; queue the exact blocked action and no-decision consequence.
mitigation: Permissions may only narrow authority
No dangerous bypass fallback

cases.title: Journal is truncated after a write failure
cases.precondition: The final JSONL record is partial or cannot be decoded after reopen.
cases.action: Resume attempts to skip the tail or trust snapshot.json instead.
detection: Stream-parse every record and verify sequence plus hash chain
Compare snapshot only as a derived cache
cases.rollback_reconcile: Freeze the run; never truncate automatically or repair authority from the snapshot.
mitigation: Flush, fsync, close, reopen, and verify every durable boundary
Keep snapshot non-authoritative

cases.title: Journal record is corrupted, reordered, or injected
cases.precondition: A record hash, previous hash, sequence, schema version, or known event type does not verify.
cases.action: Replay attempts best-effort recovery or accepts later records.
detection: Verify canonical encoding, sequence, previous hash, content hash, schema, and event enum
Reject unknown records before state derivation
cases.rollback_reconcile: Stop at the first invalid record and preserve the journal bytes for owner investigation.
mitigation: Hash-chain append-only events
Never let derived state overwrite canonical evidence

cases.title: Plan or source changes after slice compilation
cases.precondition: The plan, mandate, validation, required read, or source file hash differs from the compiled manifest.
cases.action: A pending or in-flight slice continues against mixed versions.
detection: Re-hash every frozen input before dispatch and acceptance
Distinguish pending replan from in-flight drift
cases.rollback_reconcile: Refuse in-flight or accepted drift; pending work may be recompiled only through an explicit transition.
mitigation: Use immutable manifests
Never update inputs in place

cases.title: Worker evades the frozen budget
cases.boundary: scheduler budget -> provider and worker actions
cases.precondition: The next retry, child, tool call, elapsed time, or provider usage would exceed a frozen limit or a required measurement is unknown.
cases.action: The supervisor continues because the worker recommends one more attempt or missing usage is treated as zero.
detection: Derive counters from durable events
Treat unknown load-bearing usage as unavailable, never zero
cases.rollback_reconcile: Stop dispatch; queue an owner packet when continuation needs a wider budget.
mitigation: Check budget before intent
Disallow worker-controlled retry and child budgets

cases.title: Provider schema drifts or output exceeds the cap
cases.precondition: Installed provider emits an unknown event, missing required field, malformed payload, or oversized output.
cases.action: The adapter drops the field, guesses a value, or accepts provider-specific semantics as canonical.
detection: Validate against the frozen closed envelope and byte cap
Classify unsupported and unknown distinctly
cases.rollback_reconcile: Reject the envelope; retain only bounded redacted diagnostics and do not mark the slice accepted.
mitigation: Keep provider adapters additive
Require an explicit contract update for new semantics

cases.title: Foreign dirty delta is mixed into slice acceptance
cases.precondition: The shared worktree contains changes not owned by the slice before or after worker execution.
cases.action: The supervisor attributes or commits the combined delta to the current slice.
detection: Snapshot the full preexisting worktree delta
Compare the postimage by exact path and content identity
cases.rollback_reconcile: Do not stash, revert, overwrite, or integrate foreign files; move the slice to an isolated worktree only through an explicit transition.
mitigation: One writer by default
Use linked worktrees for proven independent write slices

cases.title: Merge conflict touches a path outside assigned scope
cases.precondition: A serialized integration reports a conflict in an undeclared file or against a foreign dirty delta.
cases.action: The integrator auto-resolves the conflict to finish the slice.
detection: Compare conflict paths with slice ownership
Reject integration when the preimage no longer matches
cases.rollback_reconcile: Abort the integration operation without resetting foreign work; preserve the isolated slice commit and conflict evidence.
mitigation: Serialize merges
Require exact ownership for every conflict resolution

cases.title: Rollback is required but backup is absent or invalid
cases.precondition: A partial write is detected but the declared preimage backup is missing, unreadable, or hash-mismatched.
cases.action: The supervisor guesses a reconstruction or retries over the partial state.
detection: Verify backup presence and hash before any reversible write
Compare observed postimage with the finite recovery classes
cases.rollback_reconcile: Do not reconstruct or retry; freeze the run and expose the exact missing recovery evidence.
mitigation: Create and verify permission-restricted backups before risky writes
Refuse operations without a proven rollback path

cases.title: Concurrent supervisors acquire write authority
cases.precondition: Two processes target the same run directory or repository write lane.
cases.action: Both append intents or mutate the same slice concurrently.
detection: Acquire an exclusive lock before replay or append
Bind lock ownership to durable run identity
cases.rollback_reconcile: The losing process performs no write and reports the observed lock owner.
mitigation: Single writer is the default
Parallel writes require separate worktrees and serialized integration

cases.title: Secret or raw prompt enters durable evidence
cases.boundary: provider or worker output -> journal and terminal report
cases.precondition: Provider stderr, environment-shaped text, or worker output includes a credential-like or prohibited raw field.
cases.action: The reporter persists the raw payload for debugging or commits it as evidence.
detection: Apply allowlist minimization before durable append
Run a secret and prohibited-field retention gate
cases.rollback_reconcile: Do not append or commit the raw payload; retain only a redacted classification and require owner handling for exposed secrets.
mitigation: Store typed summaries and hashes, not transcripts
Keep credentials outside worker bundles and repository evidence

cases.title: Happy-path pilot hides a rare failure class
cases.boundary: pilot evidence -> GO or NO-GO adjudication
cases.precondition: Only successful or synthetic slices are included, or failed attempts and unknown accounting fields are omitted.
cases.action: The adjudicator reports GO from an unmatched or incomplete sample.
detection: Recompute the frozen sample eligibility and denominators
Require every terminal failure and unknown reason in the aggregate
cases.rollback_reconcile: Return NO-GO or ineligible for the affected branch; collect the missing matched evidence without changing thresholds.
mitigation: Freeze experiment order and inclusion before pilots
Use independent candidate-blind adjudication
